title: Emacs Rocks! Episode 17: Magit
summary: A three-minute Emacs Rocks screencast demonstrating Magit, the Git interface inside Emacs, including staging and other everyday operations.
why: HN users share it as the quick demo that shows what Magit can do, for people unfamiliar with it.

quote.text: I always share this demo with people to show off just a tiny portion of what it's capable of doing
